newsitem.title: INDIA: Mother Teresa to leave hospital on Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Mother Teresa to leave hospital on Saturday.

text.p: Mother Teresa, who spent several days in intensive care late last month, will be released from the hospital this weekend, her doctors said on Thursday.

"We will release her on Saturday. We want to make her slightly stronger because she may not take proper rest once she is released," said Dr S.K. Sen, medical director at Calcutta's Woodland's nursing home.
Mother Teresa, the 86-year-old Nobel peace laureate noted for her work with the poor and destitute, was taken to the hospital on August 20 suffering from malaria and mild pneumonia.
She then suffered heart failure while in intensive care.
"I am feeling well and I will listen to your advice and go by it. Please release me," Sen quoted Mother Teresa as saying.
Doctors said she still had some cardiac irregularity but there was no cause for concern.
"She is now convalescing, and we want her to convalesce in the nursing home. She was on anti-malaria medicine and the course of the medicine would end tomorrow," Sen said.
